text: a bug: [Image #1] floor pieces are not pushing the camera back at the player when under them (this is the 3rd floor in the screenshot)[Image #2]

events.text: Root cause isolated in the active editor playtest's native WorldLoader: the blank editor gamefile falls back to the live physics collider set, where thin floor rows are correctly non-solid for player stepping, but cameraOcclusionStepColliders filters every non-solid band before the spring-arm sweep. Upper-storey floor slabs therefore render and support walking yet never obstruct the camera.

Verification: the focused camera subset is 10/10 green and the three new spring-arm floor cases are 3/3 green. SHIP_RUN_PACKAGE=0 ./tools/rjit ship editor completed successfully. The whole game-physics suite is 50/51 due to the pre-existing unrelated hollow-ramp ascent test failing at frame 0. Visual and 60s spikewatch confirmation remain for the user's playtest per repository policy.

resolution: Fixed the editor playtest camera clipping through upper-storey floor pieces. Live floor slabs remain non-solid for correct player platform physics, but finite-height bands now participate in the native WorldLoader spring-arm sweep; unbounded terrain/ground rows remain excluded. Added axis-aligned, rotated, and ground-sentinel Zig regressions, updated the camera contract comments, and rebuilt the ReleaseFast editor successfully.
